data.name: Gambling Simulator - Win it All or Lose it All
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the most unhinged casino you've ever walked into, run by totally not suspicious people!

Gambling Simulator: Win It All or Lose It All is a first-person gambling simulator dripping with personality, secrets, and machines that are definitely not rigged.

What happens throughout the game is entirely up to you!

Work your way up from a broke newcomer scraping together your first $15,000 to a VIP whale rubbing elbows with the most degenerate NPCs alive. Play slots, Gachapon, Video Poker, and a growing roster of original mini-games, each with their own twisted logic, hidden personalities, and secrets that reward the curious.

But the deeper you go, the more the casino asks of you. Low on cash? No problem. You can sell your furniture. Your car. Your marriage papers. Maybe your soul? The pop-ups are always friendly about it though!

Currently in Early Access. New mini-games, floors/levels, and secrets are added regularly.

Game Features:

  • A living casino with personality — Full of NPCs, very bright neon colors and gambling machines that are waiting for you to give them a go!

  • Mini-games — Slots, Video Poker, Gachapon! Pick whichever feels best to make it big! (many more coming soon!)

  • Escalating stakes and Objections! — When you're broke, the casino gets creative. You'll get a second chance if you choose to take it by Objecting! All it takes is a small... donation. If not, you pack up and accept the game-over, leaving you even more broke than when you entered!

  • Moral Matters — Go from decent human being to absolute society scum. Your actions throughout the game will change your Moral standing. The machines and NPCs notice...

  • Multiple currencies — Cash, Membership Card Value, Debt, Coupons, and your Membership Tier all interact in surprising ways with the rest of the casino's mechanics!

  • Filled with Secrets and Easter Eggs — This one is up to you to discover!

  • Replayability — When starting a new game, a couple of parameters get generated every time resulting in a very different starting scenario. Do you happen to have 3 kids? Do you own 4 cars? Smells like extra money, wouldn't you agree?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX 5700 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800 XT (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains a (stylized) fancy, yet sometimes dark, high-stakes casino environment. Mature themes include psychological horror, simulated gambling, and the permanent physical transformation of the player character as he gambles literally everything to make cash, get rich or just lose it all trying.
